notes: Seven state episodes are visible. The two independently hinged leaves on each of the coat and laundry closets are counted separately. Their exact left/right identity during the compressed closing actions is somewhat viewpoint-ambiguous, but two distinct leaf manipulations are visible for each closet. The utensil drawer stays open continuously while the camera changes viewing angle around frames 1088–1128.
scene_description: A wearer moves from an apartment entry hallway through two storage closets and into a kitchen/living area, opening and later closing closet leaves, a refrigerator, an upper cabinet, and a utensil drawer.
